Our EXP-SP-0102-8K packs a punch as it is a powerful plug-and-play 8K HDMI splitter that has the ability to send uncompressed up to 8K@60Hz or 4K@120Hz up to two displays, but the most useful feature of this splitter is that the second output can scale content down from either 8K>4K or 4K>1080p! Furthermore, its compatible with DSC (Display Stream Compression) version 1.2a pass-through, an approved method of compression in accordance to the HDMI 2.1 specification, allowing up to a lossless 10K@120Hz signal to be transmitted.

The WyreStorm Essentials 8K splitter is the perfect addition to the modern home AV install that includes a powerful 8K display. Split captivating brand new 8K source content to another display in any home entertainment, or media room application. Downscaling allows the content to be split to a second display even if the display resolution isn't as high as the source content.

As early adopters of 4K and 8K signal distribution, we know that retrofitting is important in the dawn of new resolution standards. With our splitter, you can rest assured that you won't be forced to upgrade all displays or AVRs to 8K to reap its benefits. Just set the splitter to downscale to 4K and enjoy 8K content while supporting 4K at the same time!

Display compatibility is the last thing you need to worry about. Our splitter gives you 5 EDIDs that can be adjusted via dipswitches. The splitter also supports Smart EDID, which will auto-negotiate EDIDs based on the detected displays and adjust accordingly.
